labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The get_response argument of MiddlewareMixin.__init__() becomes required and will no longer accept None, which breaks code that relied on passing None.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The providing_args argument of django.dispatch.Signal will be removed, so code passing it will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The length argument of get_random_string() becomes required, so calls that omit it will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The list message for ModelMultipleChoiceField will be removed, so custom code or error message overrides that use it will stop working.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Passing raw column aliases to QuerySet.order_by() will be removed, so queries relying on that behavior will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The NullBooleanField model is removed (leaving only a stub for migrations), so code using it directly must be migrated to BooleanField(null=True).

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: django.conf.urls.url() will be removed, so URL configurations using it must be changed to re_path() or path().

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The postgres JSONField model is removed (leaving a stub for migrations), so models using it must switch to the builtin models.JSONField.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The postgres forms JSONField, jsonb KeyTransform, and KeyTextTransform will be removed, so code importing them will fail and needs replacement.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The {% ifequal %} and {% ifnotequal %} template tags will be removed, so templates using them must be rewritten with {% if %}.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM transitional setting will be removed, so projects relying on it must migrate to the newer hashing configuration.
